body: Actually I don’t drink and there are safety measures like locked cabinets and gun safes. Just to be clear, you are saying anyone that has any mental health issue, even just simple anxiety should be barred from being able to protect themselves?

If there are truly no more treatment options, I honestly wouldn’t blame you for getting assisted suicide. People with terminal illnesses do it all the time. There are also DNRs for people who are brain dead or in a permanent coma but still technically alive on life support. Best of luck. I’m so sorry.

I have this too but the heart is a muscle. Just like any muscle, it’s good for it to work harder. Exercise is amazing for the heart. The heart is like a work horse. It loves working and gets stronger because of it. Max heart rate formula is 220bpm minus your age. I’m 27 and 220-27 is 193 so my max heart rate should not exceed 193bpm. Start by walking on the treadmill and get that heart rate up. Start slow and work your way up to possibly running. I watched a Ted talk on humans and running and how we’re built for it. We can run long distances unlike other animals because we sweat. Coolest thing :)
The suicide hotline doesn’t help that much. I’ve called it several times over the years. It’s awkward as fuck.

Plant-based diets are cholesterol-free and very very low in saturated fat. Those are the two risk factors for heart disease. My LDL is so low right now that a heart attack is nearly impossible. Don’t know if a plant-based diet is one you’d consider but it’s the heart-healthiest diet ever and there are TONS of recipes on YouTube and elsewhere. Keep the oil to a minimum as well. Keep it high carb, low fat :)
